seo.title: Isôoko Community Development — Empowering Youth & Women in Masoro, Rwanda
seo.description: Isôoko Community Development (ICD) empowers youth and women in Masoro, Rwanda through literacy, health access, entrepreneurship, sports, and wellness programs.

hero.title: Empowering Masoro Communities
hero.subtitle: Women Empowerment · Youth Empowerment · Sports & Wellness · Digital Literacy

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: We cultivate inclusive growth and opportunities for both women and youth through enhanced health & wellbeing, literacy, and entrepreneurship. Our community center in Masoro Sector provides sports facilities, a computer lab, library, and office spaces to support a wide range of educational and recreational activities.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.subtitle: Five integrated programs for lasting community impact

cta.title: Join Us in Empowering Masoro
cta.text: Your support helps women build businesses, youth gain skills, and families thrive.
